UI_prof_RailroaderDesc: Can start and drive any locomotive without reading its manual. Better at cold starts.
UI_trait_RRRailroader_Desc:
Qualified on any locomotive without reading its manual.
A cold diesel catches more often, and a start that misses costs half the battery.
UI_RR_Opt_Desc: Locomotive volume. These sounds are not affected by the game's own Audio settings. The diesel slider applies on top of the first one.
